Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in calculating the number of laps. While correctly identifying that the track was likely the North American 440-yard (402.336 m) oval, the Planner incorrectly rounded the result of 10,000 / 402.336 (approx. 24.85) down to exactly 24 laps. In a 10,000-meter race, a runner must complete the full distance. Since 24 laps on a 402.336m track equals only 9,656 meters, the runner must complete the 25th lap to reach the 10,000m finish line. Therefore, Harry Prowell ran 25 laps, not 24.
